name: @solvent/contracts
description: On-chain filler (UniswapXAquaFiller) + tests for Solvent, a zero-inventory intent resolver on 1inch Aqua
comment: 1inch Aqua/SwapVM ship as npm packages (their foundry.toml uses libs=[node_modules]); pins mirror swap-vm@v1.0.1 exactly. Uniswap (UniswapX/permit2) ship as git submodules and are fetched by `forge install` (see justfile `setup`). limit-order-protocol's own contracts pin an exact solc (0.8.23), incompatible with this workspace's single-solc-version build (foundry.toml solc=0.8.30); postinstall relaxes that pin to a caret range so both compile together.

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const dir='node_modules/@1inch/limit-order-protocol-contract';if(!fs.existsSync(dir))process.exit(0);const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).forEach(e=>{const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(p);else if(e.name.endsWith('.sol')){const s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const r=s.replace(/^pragma solidity 0\.8\.23;/m,'pragma solidity ^0.8.23;');if(r!==s)fs.writeFileSync(p,r);}});walk(dir);"
